basic_info.description: Location! Opportunity! Views! Calling all contractors, developers, builders, flippers, owner-occupiers with vision - explore the endless potential and possibilities! Lovingly maintained, classic mid-century home owned by the same family (since 1969 when it was built) is waiting for you to bring it back to life. Original condition, providing a blank canvas for fresh updates. Cosmetic fixer with deferred maintenance - good bones but needs TLC,  ready for your personal touch. Functional layout with 3 bedrooms, 2 baths on the main level, formal living room w/ fireplace, formal dining room and spacious vintage kitchen. Significant lower level has bonus rooms and offers substantial expansion potential. Two decks (one on each level) provides breathtaking southeastern views. 2 car side-by-side garage parking. Convenient location close by to Diamond Heights Shopping Center, Glen Park Village, Glen Park BART Station, Walter Haas  Park, Glen Canyon and Freeways 280/101.
